titles.title: writeCheckpoint writes a ReviewCheckpoint JSON record to .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/checkpoint.json containing exactly {reviewId, lastCompletedUnit}, overwriting any prior checkpoint for the same reviewId
readCheckpoint resolves to undefined when no checkpoint file exists yet for a reviewId, rather than throwing
readCheckpoint resolves to the last-written ReviewCheckpoint after writeCheckpoint has been called, so a resumed review can continue from lastCompletedUnit rather than re-running completed units
readCheckpoint's own reviewId field, read back from the checkpoint record, is exactly the identity k8 requires -- the same string as both the temp folder name and the record's own content
finalizeAndCleanup copies finalOutput into durable artifact storage before deleting the .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ folder, in that order
if finalizeAndCleanup's durable copy write fails, the .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ folder is not deleted
finalizeAndCleanup is idempotent: calling it a second time for a reviewId whose temp folder was already deleted by an earlier successful call succeeds without error
writeCheckpoint called repeatedly for the same reviewId overwrites the prior checkpoint rather than accumulating a history
a reviewId containing a path-traversal segment is rejected before any filesystem access, for writeCheckpoint, readCheckpoint, and finalizeAndCleanup alike
when the reviewed repository cannot be resolved, writeCheckpoint/readCheckpoint/finalizeAndCleanup reject rather than silently defaulting to the daemon process's own cwd
a symlinked review directory or checkpoint file is never written through by writeCheckpoint, even outside .insrc/tmp

writeCheckpoint never creates a new directory through a symlinked ancestor (.insrc/tmp itself, not just the review directory) -- recursive directory creation must not silently follow a swapped ancestor out of the repository
a symlinked .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ directory is never deleted through by finalizeAndCleanup

a checkpoint.json file that is not valid JSON, or does not match ReviewCheckpoint's shape, is treated by readCheckpoint as though no checkpoint exists, rather than throwing or returning unvalidated data
finalizeAndCleanup succeeds even when checkpoint.json was never written at all, deleting whatever the .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ folder currently contains as a whole
finalizeAndCleanup propagates a permission failure during cleanup rather than reporting success (externally reported P2)
readCheckpoint rejects a mismatched identity: a checkpoint.json whose own reviewId field does not match the one requested is treated as though no checkpoint exists
readCheckpoint never follows a symlinked checkpoint.json into another review's own record, even when the symlinked record is well-formed and would otherwise pass every other check

readCheckpoint never returns a substituted record even when the original checkpoint already existed and the substitution carries the same identity as both the requested reviewId and the checkpoint it replaced

readThroughPinnedLeaf refuses a symlink already occupying the destination, proven directly -- readCheckpoint's own pinDirectoryChain call would otherwise refuse before ever reaching this, the exact state a symlink substituted after that last check would leave behind

readCheckpoint resolves to undefined, rather than rejecting, when the review directory itself is a symlink -- an ancestor-symlink failure is treated the same as an absent checkpoint, allowing a fresh start instead of aborting recovery
readCheckpoint resolves to undefined, rather than rejecting, when an ancestor is replaced by a plain file (ENOTDIR), not just a symlink

a review directory replaced by a symlink during the narrow window between writeCheckpoint's/finalizeAndCleanup's own checks and their actual use is never written through or deleted through outside the repository (best-effort concurrent regression)

an ancestor (.insrc/tmp itself) replaced by a symlink during the narrow window around writeCheckpoint's own directory creation never has a new directory created through it outside the repository (best-effort concurrent regression)
writeCheckpoint/readCheckpoint/finalizeAndCleanup and ReviewCheckpoint
